Exercise A

The vocabulary list

These are all 23 words. Nothing else is tested, here or in the test — read them once, then start Exercise B.

WordWhat it means
to skateto move on ice wearing shoes with blades
to fascinateto interest someone very strongly
explorera person who travels to learn about new places
as well asand also; in addition to
grizzly beara large, strong brown bear from North America
moosea huge animal with wide, flat antlers
harshcold, rough and unpleasant
challengingdifficult in a way that tests your skills
official languagea language that the law of a country accepts
provinceone of the large regions that make up Canada
mainlymostly; in most cases
whereasused to show a clear difference between two things
indigenous peoplethe first people who lived in a place
natural resourcesomething useful that comes from nature, like wood
irona hard grey metal used to make steel
silvera shiny grey-white metal used for jewellery
reservea large amount of oil or gas stored in the ground
to exportto sell goods to other countries
infrastructureroads, railways and the basic systems a country needs
oppressioncruel treatment that takes away people's freedom
ceremonya formal event for something important, such as a wedding
oatha serious promise, often made in court
citizenshipthe legal right to belong to a country

Choose the right meaning for each word. You can check as often as you like — the first correct answer scores a full point, the second half a point. Every word from the list comes up once.
